critique: Exceptional industrial design flat-lay. The upper dial features exactly the 9 upper radial tick marks with a completely blank bottom arc between FRESHIE and CURL CURL. All 5 beach labels and the lower 'NAH / YEAH / WORTH IT?' sub-dial are spelled and positioned accurately. The matte textured navy polymer body, single burnt-orange hand per dial, blue cutting mat, and brass vernier calipers create an authentic, tactile studio prototype aesthetic.
